clauses.text: We understand that you report an oral announcement of an increase of about 9% attributed to the renovation, and that no written notice had reached you at the time of your message.

Please tell us whether you have since received a written rent-increase notice. If so, when did it arrive, what rent and effective date does it state, and was it on the official form? Please send the notice and any evidence of its delivery date.
Please also send your lease, evidence of your current rent and its components, any prior rent adjustment, and any written reasons or calculation for the increase, if available.

For the renovation, please send any cost breakdown you have. You could also ask the landlord for invoices or contractor accounts and an allocation separating value-enhancing work from overdue maintenance.
